blocks.title: Privacy Policy
blocks.body: At ONPHARNO, we are committed to protecting the privacy and confidential proprietary data of our commercial B2B partners, clients, and website visitors.

blocks.title: Information We Collect
blocks.body: We collect business contact information (name, company name, corporate email address, telephone number, and formulation specifications) provided directly through our project inquiry and partnership forms.

blocks.title: Confidentiality & Non-Disclosure
blocks.body: All formulation briefs, active ingredient queries, and batch requirements submitted through onpharno.com are treated under strict proprietary confidentiality standards. Non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) are routinely executed prior to formulation prototyping.

blocks.title: Terms of Service
blocks.body: Welcome to onpharno.com. These Terms of Service govern your access to and use of the ONPHARNO B2B website and services.

blocks.title: B2B Informational Purpose
blocks.body: The information on this website is intended solely for business-to-business (B2B) evaluation by healthcare, pharmaceutical, and nutraceutical companies. It is not intended for direct consumer diagnosis, medical treatment, or retail sale.

blocks.title: Intellectual Property
blocks.body: All brand names, proprietary dosage designs, formulations, and graphic assets are the exclusive property of ONPHARNO and protected under relevant copyright and trademark laws.
